title: Eleven Pages and One Name
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神与科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神与科学探究）　|　核心词汇：contribution　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 contribution 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 my grandmother ① made a contribution to a survey nobody else had joined, and she said the making was the whole of the summer. The ② contribution, meaning the giving and not the credit, ran to eleven pages and stayed that length; contribution, she said, is the only thing in a survey that is judged by how little of it is asked for.

Every ③ contribution in that report had the same handwriting, and the ④ contribution at the end, meaning the one she kept for the appendix and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Contribution, my mother said, is nine pages handwriting and one part somebody willing to send it in; my grandmother said the sending in is the part that fills the summer.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the contribution was the whole of the pension, meaning the paying in and not the giving. The ⑥ contribution, meaning the paying in and not any of that, is the only thing in a pension that everybody makes and nobody watches; contribution, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a giving and a paying in. She said the paying in is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ contribution had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the handwriting. The ⑧ contribution of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in July, was one survey and thirty years of sending in; contribution, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to send it in. He said the sending in was never mentioned.

The ⑨ contribution I remember is the one at the end, which she sent in 1979 and is still described as the longest in the county. A ⑩ contribution, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being thanked; every contribution, she said, is a paying in that has agreed to look like a giving. She said the paying in was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 贡献（指那份付出本身，与那份荣誉相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a contribution to 为……作出贡献
D. n. 稿件；来稿（指那份报告里每一份）
E. n. 稿件（指末尾那一份）
F. n. 缴款；供款（指定期缴入的钱，如养老金供款）
G. n. 贡献（指账目里提到的那一项）
H. n. 贡献；助力（抽象总称）

items.q: made a contribution to a survey nobody else had joined
The contribution, meaning the giving and not the credit
the contribution was the whole of the pension
The contribution, meaning the paying in
the contribution had become a line in an account
The contribution of the whole thing
A contribution, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: make a contribution to 意为“为……作出贡献”，1965 年祖母为一项没有别人参加的调查作出了贡献。
contribution 意为“贡献”，指那份付出本身而不是那份荣誉，写了十一页。
contribution 指那份报告里每一份来稿，每一份都是同样的笔迹。
contribution 指末尾那一份（她留给附录的那一份），是唯一有人谢过两次的。
contribution 意为“缴款、供款”，父亲说供款就是那份养老金的全部，指的是定期缴入的钱而不是那份付出。
contribution 为另一个义项，指定期缴入的钱而不是那份付出，是养老金里人人都缴、却无人留意的东西。
contribution 意为“贡献”，指账目里提到的那一项，到 1973 年这项贡献成了账目里的一行。
contribution 意为“贡献、助力”，祖母七月写道，整件事的贡献是一项调查三十年的投稿。
contribution 意为“贡献”，我记得的是末尾那一份，她 1979 年寄出，至今仍被说成全县最长的。
contribution 为抽象总称，母亲说一份贡献是唯一会因为被致谢而变好的东西。
